jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Wahed:**
The global financial system wasn't built for everyone. For millions of people, its reliance on interest (riba) creates a barrier to managing money and building wealth without compromising their values.

At Wahed, we're changing that. We are a global fintech company on a mission to build a new financial system—one that is ethical, accessible, and entirely interest\-free. From our offices across the globe, our team is building products that were once deemed impossible, from pioneering Shariah\-compliant equity ETFs, creating true riba\-free alternatives to high yield savings accounts, to creating no\-leverage real estate investments for truly interest\-free income producing assets. If you're driven to solve complex problems and believe finance should empower, not exclude, join us in building a more equitable financial future.  



**Job Brief:**
We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to join our Core development team. As a team member, you will play a role in building, maintaining, designing, and implementing new and current features primarily on the Wahed Platform, a React Native app. Building product and innovative features is a highly collaborative effort, and as such, a strong team player with a commitment to perfection is required. We are looking for candidates that are self\-motivated and eager to learn new technologies, work well both within a team and on their own, and have an attention to detail.
### **Job Description:**

* Development of the React Native architecture including creating and maintaining core mobile components.
* Work with other senior engineers to drive and deliver on our product roadmap, turning rough specs into features.
* Provide leadership and mentorship to other frontend and mobile engineers on the team.
* Find elegant solutions to usability problems. Build pixel\-perfect, buttery smooth UIs across both all our frontend platforms.
* Engineer new features that can work seamlessly across all of maintained web and mobile applications.
* Leverage APIs for integrations with other platforms.

### **Job Specification:**

* At least 2 years of recent experience working with React Native.
* At least 7 years of commercial experience with JavaScript and TypeScript and its nuances, including ES6\+ syntax, React, React Native and GraphQL
* Product minded: committed to building the best user experience.
* Understand the trade\-offs in employing different engineering solutions to a problem, valuing pragmatism over idealism.
* Eager and open to learning.
* General understanding of Swift, Objective\-C and Java.
* Experience with AWS.
* Experience with Server\-side JS e.g. Node JS.
* Familiar with event\-based and microservices architectures.
* Understanding the standards and rules regulated by the Apple Developer/Connect system.
* Have an app hosted publicly in the Google or Apple app store(s).


We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Operations Excellence
jobs.description:
**Job description**
-------------------

 **Who We Are**


NEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and momentum becomes movement. As a global platform revolutionising access to performance\-based capital, we empower the world’s most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, FundedNext, we empower dreamers to become doers, and potential to turn into performance. With 500\+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm—220,000\+ daily users from 170\+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.

 **Your Role in Our Mission**


As the Product Manager for Operations Excellence at FNMarkets, you will define and drive the product vision within the trading and brokerage domain, ensuring seamless experience for our customers by automating operational workflows and creating exceptional tools for the internal stakeholders. By aligning business priorities, and regulatory requirements, you will lead cross\-functional teams to build scalable, high\-impact fintech solutions that strengthen our competitive advantage.

 **How You’ll Make an Impact**

**Product Vision \& Strategy**

* Define and communicate the product vision and roadmap for assigned product areas
* Align product initiatives with business goals, user needs, and market opportunities
* Identify growth opportunities through structured discovery and user research

**Product Execution \& Delivery**

* Own and prioritize the product backlog, translating requirements into clear user stories and acceptance criteria
* Collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, QA, and Operations to ensure high\-quality, on\-time releases
* Lead internal rollouts and training to drive adoption across operations and support teams

**Performance \& Compliance**

* Define product success metrics and continuously optimize based on data and user feedback
* Work closely with Compliance and Risk teams to ensure regulatory alignment in all product developments

 **What You Bring**

* 5\+ years of Product Management experience in fintech and brokerage environments
* Sufficient technical literacy in AI technologies (e.g., Claude, agent frameworks) to distinguish feasible solutions from impractical ideas.
* Technical fluency to collaborate with engineers on APIs, database structures, and system architecture
* Experience applying data\-driven prioritization frameworks such as RICE, Kano, or similar
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate business objectives into actionable technical requirements
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Finance, or a related field

 **Your X\-Factor**

* Demonstrated success launching and scaling trading or brokerage products in competitive fintech environments
* Strong commercial acumen — balancing user experience, regulatory requirements, and revenue impact
* Ownership mindset with a track record of delivering measurable product outcomes in high\-growth settings

**Your Journey after Applying**

* 30 minute HR interview with the Talent Acquisition team member
* 45 minute Problem Solving Interview (with talent acquisition team \& department front line manager)
* 60\-minute Bar Raiser Interview (with head of department \& talent acquisition lead)

**Why Join NEXT**


At NEXT Ventures, we believe the right talent fuels breakthrough innovation. If you're driven to connect great minds with big ideas and want to shape the future of fintech, we’d love to meet you. Join our team of bold thinkers where technology meets transformation.


Apply now and be part of our journey — the future is calling, and it starts with you.

jobs.title: AI Agentic Developer
jobs.description:
EC\-Council is the world’s largest cyber security technical certification body. We operate in 145 countries globally and we are the owner and developer of various world\-famous cyber security programs. We are proud to have trained and certified over 400,000 information security professionals globally that have influenced the cyber security mindset of countless organizations worldwide.

**www.eccouncil.org**

**Position Overview:**

EC\-Council is seeking a driven and technically capable Agentic AI Developer to join our growing AI Engineering team. In this mid\-level role, you will contribute to the design and development of multi\-agent systems, integrate agentic tooling into production pipelines, and help build intelligent automation solutions that power our next\-generation cybersecurity and compliance platforms

**Your Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain agentic pipelines using LangChain and LangGraph, including tool\-use chains, ReAct loops, and stateful multi\-step reasoning workflows.
* Build and extend Agent Harness components — defining tool schemas, agent personas, execution environments, and guardrail configurations.
* Implement and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) server and client integrations for structured tool invocation across agent pipelines.
* Develop Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) communication flows — including task delegation, shared context management, and inter\-agent messaging protocols.

**Required Technical Skills:**

* Agentic Framework — LangChain \& LangGraph
* LLM Integration — Claude SDK (Anthropic)
* Agent Infrastructure — Agent Harness Design
* Protocol — Model Context Protocol (MCP)
* Multi\-Agent Systems — Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) Comms
* Model Development — Fine\-Tuning \& Evaluation
* Frontend — React \& HTMX
* Agentic Tooling — Tool Use, RAG, Function Calling

**Required Experience:**

* 2–4 years in software or AI/ML engineering, with at least 1 year on agentic or LLM\-powered systems.
* Hands\-on experience building agent pipelines with LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of model fine\-tuning using Hugging Face, OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar.
* Familiarity with vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, Chroma) for agent memory and retrieval.
* Proficiency in Python; basic TypeScript knowledge is a plus.

**Nice to Have:**

* Exposure to CrewAI, AutoGen, or other multi\-agent orchestration frameworks.
* Basic familiarity with graph databases such as Neo4j.
* Understanding of cybersecurity concepts — VAPT, compliance, or threat modelling.
* Experience with streaming LLM responses via SSE or WebSockets.
* Interest in regulated industry deployments (fintech, healthcare, or government).

**What You Will Build:**

As a mid\-level developer at EC\-Council Sdn. Bhd., you will contribute directly to AI\-poweredcybersecurity platforms, compliance automation tools, and multi\-agent orchestration systems —working alongside senior engineers to ship production\-grade agentic solutions at enterprise scale.

* Multi\-agent orchestration workflows with supervisor, planner, executor, and validator agent roles.
* MCP server integrations enabling structured, secure tool invocation across security and compliance workflows.
* Fine\-tuned models and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines for domain\-specific task performance.
* React \+ HTMX interfaces delivering real\-time agentic interactions and streaming task outputs to end users.

**About Our Culture:**

EC\-Council is driven by a mission to strengthen global cybersecurity capability and advance the profession of ethical hacking and information security. Our teams operate across regions and cultures, united by integrity, professionalism, and a commitment to meaningful impact. Continuous learning and accountability are encouraged, empowering individuals to take ownership of their contributions. Respect, trust, and ethical conduct guide how we work with colleagues, partners, and the global cybersecurity community.

**Additional Information:**

EC\-Council is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. We do not discriminate based on these or any other characteristics protected by applicable laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

EC\-Council is dedicated to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you have a medical condition or disability that limits your ability to complete any part of the application process and require reasonable accommodation, please contact us at ecchr.sea@eccouncil.org and let us know how we can assist.

To be eligible for this position, candidates must be able to provide proof that they are either a citizen of the country or have legal authorization to work in the country where the position is posted and are currently residing there. EC\-Council does not offer employment to ineligible candidates and reserves the right to revoke employment in case the candidate loses the authorization to work.

If, as part of the recruitment process, you are required to complete or submit any form of work, project, case study, or assignment, please note that such material will be considered the exclusive property of EC\-Council. By submitting such work, you acknowledge that EC\-Council retains all rights, title, and interest in the submitted content, including any intellectual property contained therein.

Candidates further waive any intellectual property or moral rights in such submissions, confirm that the work is original and free of third\-party infringement, and acknowledge that it is provided solely for evaluation purposes, with no ownership or other rights retained.

Our Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data during the recruitment process. This may include information such as your name, contact details, employment history, qualifications, and any other details you provide as part of your application. All data is handled in compliance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.

Please review our policy here: EC\-Council Privacy Policy – User and Company \| EC\-Council. Submission of your application will be considered as your acceptance of the terms stated above.

Benefits:

* Additional leave
* Flexible schedule
* Professional development

Application Question(s):

* How long is your notice period?
* How much is your current salary?
* How much is your expected salary?

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior UI/UX Designer (Banking / Financial Domain)
jobs.description:
The designer is responsible for developing and driving design solutions (process flows, sketches, scenarios, wireframes, navigation models, visual design) for applications, software, and other forms of interfaces. In this role, you will take an active and hands\-on role in supporting the creative, engineering and project/account management teams. You will also work closely with clients and be responsible for conducting user and stakeholder research activities including user interviews, ideation sessions, usability studies and other user research techniques to inform a human\-centred design for the project.

**Role Overview**

At Aleph, we design human experiences by asking the right questions. We are looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer who is a master of craft and a strategic leader capable of driving high\-level design solutions for complex financial applications. In this role, you will take a hands\-on leadership position, steering creative and engineering teams while acting as a trusted advisor to our banking and fi ntech clients. You will defi ne the design vision, ensuring that digital solutions remain human\-centered, elegant, and technologically cutting\-edge

**Key Responsibilities** 

1\. Design Strategy \& Leadership (Financial Focus)  
● Strategic Vision: Develop UI/UX strategies that align with banking brand identities and long\-term business goals, such as digital transformation in retail or corporate banking.  
● Creative Direction: Lead and mentor designers to deliver cohesive, tailored user experiences for complex financial products like wealth management tools or lending platforms.  
● Innovation Oversight: Implement the latest design innovations, including AI\-driven financial insights and secure biometric authentication interfaces.  
● Process Excellence: Defi ne design workflows and scalable style guides that adhere to financial accessibility and security standards.

2\. Client\-Facing \& Financial Stakeholder Partnership  
● Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary design contact for banking clients, conducting research with financial subject matter experts and end\-users.  
● Consultative Approach: Translate complex fi nancial business needs (e.g., regulatory compliance, transaction fl ows) into intuitive design solutions.  
● Requirement Gathering: Lead workshops with engineers and product managers to refi ne user requirements for secure, high\-stakes financial environments.  
● Expert Advocacy: Present design concepts and research findings with conviction to influence executive\-level banking stakeholders.

3\. User Research \& UX Engineering  
● Advanced Research: Lead usability studies and competitor analysis specifically within the fintech and traditional banking landscapes.  
● Prototyping \& Flow: Produce high\-quality wireframes and interactive prototypes to solve specific user problems, such as simplifying complex fund transfers or account registrations.  
● Optimization: Define user task flows for financial operations, continuously testing designs for intuitiveness and trust.  
● Gap Analysis: Conduct usability testing to identify design gaps in financial interfaces and lead iterative improvement strategies.

**Prerequisites**   
**● Experience: 6\+ years of professional design experience, preferably with a background in Banking or Financial domain.**

**● Required to interact with stakeholders based in Australia.**

● Domain Knowledge: Understanding of financial user journeys, data visualization for portfolios, and security\-focused UI patterns.  
● Strategic Mindset: Strong ability to solve complex design problems through research and strategic thinking.  
● Technical Mastery: Proficient in industry\-standard tools (Sketch, Photoshop, Keynote) and animation tools like Principle.  
● Leadership Qualities: Excellent interpersonal skills; you must be meticulous and "addicted" to the quality of craft.  
● UX Foundations: Deep knowledge of user research, usability testing, and visual hierarchy.

Pay: RM4,315\.44 \- RM8,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Opportunities for promotion
* Professional development

Application Question(s):

* Required to interact with stakeholders based in Australia.
* Banking experience

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Engineer (AI/ Full-stack/ Data), Credit Innovation Group
jobs.location: Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
jobs.description:
**Company Description** 




 AEON Credit Service (M) Berhad ("AEON Credit") is a leading financial services provider in Malaysia, incorporated in 1996 and listed on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia since 2007\. The company offers a wide range of financial solutions, including credit cards, prepaid cards, easy payment schemes, motor vehicle financing, personal financing, and insurance brokerage services. With a robust network comprising five regional offices, 63 branches, and over 8,100 participating merchant outlets nationwide, AEON Credit continues to enhance its services through innovative offerings like the AEON Wallet app. Headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, AEON Credit is part of the AEON Group, leveraging its retail network and ecosystem to deliver market\-leading solutions.
 



  





**Main Purpose of Job** 




 To support strategic and explorative innovation initiatives within the Credit Innovation Group by conducting investigations, R\&D, parallel sandbox testing, and stakeholder handholding during change\-management.
 



  





**Role Description** 



* Drive innovation within the Credit Innovation Group by identifying operational problems, developing and testing solutions, and supporting adoption across the organization.
* Conduct regular problem framing (Frame\-storming) and maintain an ongoing list of problem statements across the organization.
* Ideate potential solutions and validate them with in\-depth feasibility investigations.
* Serve as subject matter expert in at least one skill domain (full\-stack development / AI\-enabled automations / data)
* Get involved hands\-on in solution design and development
* Prepare materials for prototyping proposals, validation success criteria, validation outcome reports, technical documentation, and innovation playbooks.
* Manage the lifecycle of any innovation initiatives, including discovery, development, validation, refinement cycle, and change management handholding.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure successful adoption of innovations.
* Drive AI\-usage practices within the Credit Operations Division.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Minimum 3 years work experience in a technical OR techno\-functional role, preferably with experience in credit processes / fintech / start\-ups / digital platforms.
* Hands on experience in any one of the following areas Full\-stack Development / AI\-enabled Automations / Tech product development / Data Modelling / Data Analysis / Technical pre\-sales.
* Project management skills, including the ability to coordinate with cross\-functional teams and meet deadlines.
* Excellent problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills.
* Ability to work on\-site in a collaborative environment and adapt to dynamic challenges.
* Prior experience in the financial services or fintech sector is a plus.
